Yet their realized single outcomes (1 vs 2) DIFFER. So the realized-outcome map does NOT factor through the QM ensemble object map: there is no phi with (realized-outcome) = phi(ensemble-readout). The single-outcome selection is non-definable from QM's pre-collapse Sigma_f (non-factorization confirmed as the descent obstruction).

rationale: E032 is the QUANTUM MEASUREMENT PROBLEM as an UP edge: from the QM ensemble/amplitude layer to the readout of a SINGLE definite realized outcome on one run. It must be kept sharply distinct from its two easier neighbours that the QM card itself splits off: the DECOHERENCE/dephasing shadow (E006, E1) supplies the diagonal ENSEMBLE given a chosen pointer basis, and the BORN-WEIGHTS recognition (E007, E2 via Gleason) supplies the probability VALUES -- but NEITHER supplies the selection of WHICH single outcome is realized. The faithful finite descent test confirms the selection does not factor through QM's ensemble Sigma_f: xi_rel = 1.0 stably at both refinements (d=3, d=5), with an explicit non-factorization witness (two runs identical on every QM ensemble probe but with different realized outcomes) and an over-read counterfactual (xi_rel -> 0 only by importing the collapse/projection postulate, content not in QM's Sigma_f -- the E005-style over-read gate E.3 refuses it). So NOT E1. The recognition-search returns no single accepted named principle -- only mutually-incompatible interpretations (many-worlds, objective collapse, Bohmian, QBism), a menu, not a frozen import -- so NOT E2 (this is exactly why the framework must NOT over-read E007's Gleason import as also closing the selection). No constructible run-object generates 'the realized outcome' on QM's substrate (unitary QM yields the ensemble, not a single label) -- so NOT E0; nothing to defer. The obstruction is located (the diagonal-ensemble -> single-outcome step) and typed (non-factorization / non-definability from QM's Sigma_f), but explicitly NOT closed: a sharpened gap = E3, primary modality emergence-up. SBT is SILENT on which interpretation is correct; recording E3 prevents over-reading the decoherence shadow (E006) or the Born import (E007) as if they selected an outcome.
